profile.headline: Software Engineer | Frontend | React.js | Remix | a11y - accessibility | Ruby on Rails
profile.summary:
Full-stack Software Engineer using HTML , CSS, Javascript, and Python Frameworks to help people and businesses create interactive and attractive web pages.  Transitioning into the software industry to make a positive contribution in a team dynamic. 

Former casino dealer accustomed to working in fast-paced environments in high pressure situations. Excellent communication skills and customer service. Dedicated to completing projects on time and assisting clients and businesses modernize. 

Technical Skills:
• Language : Javascript, Python, HTML, CSS, Node.js
• Front End : Bootstrap, Bulma, XML/JSON
• Back End : Flask, REST API, Express
• Development and Deployment: Git, Github, Postman, Insomnia, Heroku

positions.title: Mental Health Coach
positions.locationName: Los Angeles County, California, United States
positions.description:
•Implemented motivational interviewing techniques to help walk participants suffering from anxiety and depression through the different behavioral techniques to help manage their emotions.
•Train and certify on various modules and cognitive behavioral therapy techniques as a continued effort and commitment to learning and providing the best treatment possible.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborate with a team of developers to build modern and responsive web applications using best practices.
• Built semantically structured full stack web applications.
• Applied agile methodologies like SCRUM for project management.

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description:
• Retained as a paid consultant to help streamline functions and 
flows throughout the website prior to establishing design
work with a 3rd party.
• Helped to exceed goals and stayed on throughout the design process to make sure that visual elements aligned with outline
goals. Coordinated work between marketing goals, design team creations, and my own solo end of function to ensure
everything worked smoothly.
• Worked with with parent company to design a B2B website for supplement formula writing company.

positions.title: Poker Dealer
positions.description:
•Dealt various card games including Texas Hold 'Em , Omaha, and Mexican Poker. 
•Mental calculations for pot sizes and bet sizing . 
•Monitored game to ensure that no cheating happened. 
•Worked quickly and efficiently to ensure that the game moved along quickly to maximize company profits. 
•Highly sociable and provided a pleasant experience for customers.

positions.title: Poker Dealer
positions.description:
•Dealt various card games including Texas Hold 'Em , Omaha, and 13-Card Poker. 
•Learned various poker based card games and coordinated the game. 
•Ensured that all players played fairly and monitored the game closely to ensure that there was no misconduct. 
•Instructed new players in the mechanics of the game and directed them to any additional services they required.

positions.title: Third Party Proposition Player
positions.description:
•Worked as a banker for various California games at the Bicycle Hotel and Casino through Knighted
  Ventures. 
•Work consisted of monitoring game activity in a fast paced environment to ensure that the integrity of
  the games were kept and that all of the proper procedures were followed. 
•Attention to detail was an absolute must as there was tens of thousands of dollars moving on the
  tables every minute. 
•Learned rules and procedures of several table games and was accustomed to training constantly to
  keep up to date with new casino policies.

positions.title: Employment Specialist
positions.description:
•Provided employment services under the WIOA Integrated Service Delivery model
•As part of the placement team worked directly with employers to help clients find work. 
•Worked in Southeast Los Angeles Area to help develop new job opportunities. 
•Assisted small businesses in helping fulfill needs regarding, modernizing websites , outreach, and marketing efforts.

positions.title: Career Planner
positions.description:
•Managing participant cases under the set of programs provided by WIOA formerly WIA.
•Working specifically with the Adult and Out of School youth populations. 
•Assisted individual participants by helping them find training programs that suited their needs and helped them connect to training related employment upon completion.
•Assisted youth with reentering post secondary education and referring high school dropouts to continuation school to assist them with finishing their high school diplomas.

projects.title: Meme Generator
projects.description: Create your own memes and fight the war on Covid by staying home and sharing memes instead of actual interacting with people.
